11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A scientist who has studied an unusual plant for weeks announces a discovery at last.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has spent weeks investigating an unusual plant. Today (subject.he/she) announces that (subject.he/she) has finally made a discovery. (friend) rushes over, expecting something extraordinary.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) produces several pages of careful observations concerning the plant's appearance, growth, and unpleasant flavor. (friend) is impressed by the thoroughness. "Are you going to publish this?" "Perhaps," says (subject). "After I get the taste out of my mouth."

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: "It tastes terrible," (subject) announces. (friend) stares. "That's your discovery?" "An important one," says (subject). "Now we know not to put it in soup." (friend) admits this is useful information.
